tagline: A calculator that stays out of the way.
description: A small, fast calculator for the arithmetic you do while working on something else. It opens in a compact window, does the four operations and percentages, and takes keyboard input — digits, operators, Enter, Backspace and Escape — so you never have to reach for the mouse.
capabilities: Addition, subtraction, multiplication, division and percentages.
Full keyboard input, including Enter to evaluate, Backspace to correct and Escape to clear.
Compact window that fits next to whatever else you have open.
